**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure hasn't been identified yet — that investigation is flagged in the incident for follow-up.
